newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon weekly CDs raise 15 bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon weekly CDs raise 15 bln pounds.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon issued on Thursday certificates of deposit dated November 8 to commercial banks worth 15 billion Lebanese pounds compared with four billion last week.
The Bank sold 45-day CDs worth 11 billion pounds compared with three billion last week. It sold 60-day CDs worth four billion pounds compared with one billion last week.
Interest rates on the 45- and 60-day CDs were 12.50 percent and 13.25 percent respectively, unchanged from last week.
